title: INTRODUCTION TO UNIVERSITY LISTENING AND SPEAKING
description: Students will improve their ability to understand main ideas, important details, and implied meanings of authentic academic speech. They will listen to audio and video lectures, participate in in-class discussions, improve their note-taking skills, and conduct basic research that they will present in formal and informal in-class presentations.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment is limited to INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways level students.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
